questions.scenario: Two friends are looking at a family photo album.
questions.question:
Friend A: This man is tall. ___________________
Friend B: Yes, he is. He works in a hospital.
questions.explanation: 從回答 Yes, he is. 與在醫院工作的線索，可以推論前言在詢問第三人稱單數男性的職業。疑問句為 Is he a/an + 職業名詞。選項 B 主詞錯置；選項 C 錯搭助動詞 does；選項 D 語序錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 疑問句忘了將 Be 動詞移至句首，或是錯加助動詞 does 在名詞前面。

questions.scenario: A teacher is showing flashcards of different jobs to the class.
questions.question:
Teacher: Look at the woman in the picture. Is she a nurse?
Student: ___________________
options: Yes, she is. She is a teacher.
No, she isn't. She is a teacher.
No, she doesn't. She is teacher.
Yes, it is. It is a teacher.
questions.explanation: 問句為 Is she...?，若為否定則回答 No, she isn't.，並且補述時需要加上冠詞 a (a teacher)。選項 B 錯搭 doesn't 且漏了 a；選項 C 語意矛盾 (是護士卻又說是老師)；選項 D 把人稱作 it。
questions.commonMisconception: 否定簡答不熟，且職業名詞前方常會漏掉不定冠詞 a / an。

questions.scenario: A child is pointing at a police car on the street.
questions.question:
Child: Look at the man in the car! ___________________
Dad: Yes, he is a brave police officer.
questions.explanation: 由爸爸的回答 he is 推斷，小孩的問句必定是 Is he a...。選項 B 錯用女性；選項 C Be 動詞搭配錯誤；選項 D 錯用 does 加在名詞上。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看清楚情境裡的 the man (男人)，亂選 she，或把 does 亂加在名詞前。

questions.scenario: A girl tells her friend about her mother's job.
questions.question:
Girl: My mother cooks very well in the restaurant.
Friend: ___________________
questions.explanation: 母親在餐廳很會煮菜，符合的職業是廚師 (cook)。提問女性長輩使用 Is she a cook?。選項 B 護士與情境不符；選項 C 動詞錯用 are；選項 D 為直述句語法。
questions.commonMisconception: 不會聯想 cooks (煮飯) 與 a cook (廚師) 的關係，或者把問句語序搞錯。

questions.scenario: Two students meet the school's new staff member.
questions.question:
Student A: Is he a teacher?
Student B: ___________________
Student A: Oh, he cleans the school.
questions.explanation: 根據後續對話「Oh, he cleans...」(他是打掃的人)，推論出他不是老師。Is he...? 的否定簡答為 No, he isn't.。選項 B 與 D 錯搭助動詞 does；選項 C 不合邏輯語意。
questions.commonMisconception: 看到動詞 cleans 就想選 does，而忘記要針對 Is he 進行對等回答。

questions.scenario: A boy is reading a book about flying planes.
questions.question:
Boy: I want to fly planes in the sky.
Dad: ___________________
options: Are you want to be a pilot?
Do you want to be a pilot?
Is you want to be a pilot?
Does you want to be a pilot
questions.explanation: 動詞 want 是一般動詞，因此提問必須使用助動詞 Do/Does。因為主詞是 you，故必須用 Do you want...。選項 B, C 錯用了 Be 動詞；選項 D 錯用了 Does。
questions.commonMisconception: 被『你是...嗎』的句型干擾，導致遇到一般動詞也套用 Are you。

questions.scenario: A little girl is dressing up with a stethoscope (聽診器).
questions.question:
Grandpa: You look great. ___________________
Girl: Yes! I want to help sick people.
questions.explanation: 對著眼前的人問身分，使用 Are you a...? 是正確且符合語法的。女孩回答想幫助病人，確認了醫生這個職業。選項 B 錯搭 Is you ；選項 C 的 Do 無法直接接名詞補語；選項 D 人稱反了。
questions.commonMisconception: 把助動詞的用法完全搞混，把 Do you 拿來問身分。

questions.scenario: Two kids are talking about the man performing on stage.
questions.question:
Kid A: Wow! He has a great voice.
Kid B: ___________________
Kid A: Yes, he is a famous singer.
questions.explanation: 選項 A 是標準的第三人稱單數疑問句，契合 Kid A 所描述的男歌手 he is a famous singer。選項 B Be 動詞錯置；選項 C 是女性 she 不符；選項 D 為直述句語句錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意到前面的 he has，看成女性的 she。

questions.scenario: Mom brings a package to the door from a delivery person.
questions.question:
Son: Is he a mail carrier?
Mom: ___________________
Son: I see. He works for the brown truck company.
questions.explanation: 因為兒子說「我了解了。他在那家棕色卡車公司工作（而非傳統的郵差）」，得知答案為否定。Is he...? 的否定短答是 No, he isn't.。選項 B 重大文法錯誤 (doesn't對應Is)，選項 C 與對話邏輯矛盾。
questions.commonMisconception: 在簡答中，用 does/doesn't 去取代 is/isn't，對於 Be 動詞缺乏敏感性。

questions.scenario: The teacher points to a picture of an old woman feeding animals.
questions.question:
Teacher: What does she do? Is she a farmer?
Student: ___________________
options: Yes, he is. He loves animals.
Yes, she is. She loves animals.
No, she isn't. He loves animals
No, she doesn't. She loves it.
questions.explanation: 圖中是一位『老奶奶』(woman/she)，問題為 Is she...?。肯定回答必須是 Yes, she is.。選項 B、C 把人稱錯變成了男性 he，選項 D 錯用 doesn't 來回答 Is 提問。
questions.commonMisconception: 看到 animals 以為要用 does 回答，忘了原本問的是 Is she a farmer (身分身分身分)。
